command:
set -euo pipefail
echo '=== BEFORE ==='
systemctl --user is-active clay-local-bridge.service 2>/dev/null || true
systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-local-bridge.service 2>/dev/null || true
echo '=== STOP LEGACY GENERIC-BRANCH DAEMON ==='
systemctl --user disable --now clay-local-bridge.service
echo '=== AFTER ==='
printf 'legacy='; systemctl --user is-active clay-local-bridge.service 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'canonical='; systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-local-bridge.service
echo '=== PIDS ==='
pgrep -af 'local_bridge.*daemon.py|clay-local-bridge/bin/daemon.py' || true
echo '=== AVATAR SERVICE ==='
systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-buehne.service
LIVE=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual/buehne.html
printf 'filesystem_sha256='; sha256sum "$LIVE" | awk '{print $1}'
TMP=$(mktemp)
trap 'rm -f "$TMP"' EXIT
curl -fsS -H 'Cache-Control: no-cache' http://127.0.0.1:8788/ -o "$TMP"
printf 'http_sha256='; sha256sum "$TMP" | awk '{print $1}'
printf 'http_bytes='; wc -c < "$TMP"
printf 'shadow_marker_count='; grep -c 'go-eye-shadow' "$TMP" || true
printf 'canonical_eye_builder_refs='; grep -cE 'augen_blink|blinzeln\(' "$TMP" || true
echo 'SCOPE=REAL_HOST_BRIDGE_CANONICALIZATION_AND_READ_ONLY_AVATAR_RUNTIME_HEALTH'
